summary: The registrant, Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A., filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, furnishing a press release and presentation regarding its preliminary unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The filing reports record quarterly net gaming revenue of €64.4 million, a 13% increase YoY, and Adjusted EBITDA of €6.0 million. Net income was €7.0 million. The company maintains a cash position of €56.2 million with no financial debt. No special situation (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event.
